purpose: Replace the two incomplete independently displayed resting/thinking arm assets with fully redrawn complete originals.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE independent complete transparent pixel-art cow arm for a layered animation. Image 1 is the original pixel cow desk scene: STYLE and thinking-pose reference only. Image 2 is the matching navy hoodie: fabric, color and sleeve construction reference only. Redraw from scratch ONLY the VIEWER-LEFT THINKING ARM in a natural bent pose. Draw a complete navy upper sleeve from a rounded shoulder root at UPPER LEFT, descending to a bent elbow at LOWER LEFT, then a short ivory cow forearm rises diagonally UP AND RIGHT from the dark ribbed cuff, ending in a large rounded dark-charcoal bovine hoof at UPPER RIGHT, ready to rest below the cow chin. The arm is one connected anatomically coherent L/V-shaped object: entire shoulder cap, sleeve, elbow, cuff, cream wrist and dark hoof must be fully drawn even the formerly hidden areas. Keep generous navy sleeve thickness and original short broad cream wrist/hoof proportions, natural bent elbow, no extremely elongated forearm. Complete closed stepped dark outline throughout, opaque fabric and wrist interiors, no missing chunks, no white holes in navy sleeve, no transparent cracks or detached slivers. Match original soft chunky PIXEL ART, dark navy-black hoodie with muted gray cloth folds, ivory fur with light beige shadow, broad charcoal hoof with warm gray highlight. Full entire asset visible with 12 percent transparent padding and no cropping. Isolated single arm on REAL TRANSPARENT background. No head, eyes, mouth, neck, chest, torso, drawstrings, logo, second arm, desk, books, laptop, mug or props. No human fingers, no open empty cuff, no smooth vector lines, no captions or watermarks. The thinking hoof is upper-right and the shoulder is upper-left, the elbow is lowest on the left. Render the whole arm as an independent completed painting, never a crop from the source scene.
